q: A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost, in cents? Give a single number.
A snail is at the bottom of a 10-foot well. Each day it climbs up 3 feet, but each night it slips back 2 feet. On which day (numbered from 1) does it first reach the top? Give a single number.
If 3 painters can paint 3 houses in 3 days, how many painters are needed to paint 9 houses in 9 days? Give a single number.
What is the remainder when 7^100 is divided by 13? Give a single number.
How many trailing zeros does 25! (25 factorial) have? Give a single number.
How many distinct arrangements are there of the letters in the word BANANA? Give a single number.
How many squares of all sizes are there on a standard 8x8 chessboard? Give a single number.
What is the units digit of 3^2024? Give a single number.
In a 24-hour period, how many times do the hour and minute hands of an analog clock overlap? Give a single number.

Two trains are 100 miles apart on the same track, approaching each other, each at 50 mph. A fly flies at 75 mph back and forth between them until they meet. How many total miles does the fly travel? Give a single number.
What is the sum of the interior angles of a heptagon (7-sided polygon), in degrees? Give a single number.
How many diagonals does an octagon (8-sided polygon) have? Give a single number.
Remove two diagonally opposite corner squares from a standard 8x8 chessboard, leaving 62 squares. Can the board be fully tiled by 31 dominoes (each covering two adjacent squares)? Answer yes or no.

In the Monty Hall problem with 3 doors, you pick a door, the host opens a different door revealing a goat, and you switch to the remaining door. What is your probability of winning the car? Give it as a fraction.
How many positive divisors does 360 have? Give a single number.
What is the 10th Fibonacci number, using the convention F(1)=1, F(2)=1? Give a single number.
What is the next term in the sequence 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ...? Give a single number.
What is the greatest common divisor of 48 and 180? Give a single number.
If you flip a fair coin 3 times, what is the probability of getting exactly 2 heads? Give it as a fraction.
At a party of 10 people, everyone shakes hands with everyone else exactly once. How many handshakes occur in total? Give a single number.
A lily pad patch doubles in size every day and covers the whole pond on day 48. On which day did it cover half the pond? Give a single number.
If 5 machines take 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, how many minutes would 100 machines take to make 100 widgets? Give a single number.
What is the remainder when 1 + 2 + 3 + ... + 100 is divided by 7? Give a single number.
A 3x3x3 cube is painted on all outer faces, then cut into 27 unit cubes. How many of the unit cubes have exactly two painted faces? Give a single number.
